components.name: Self-Service Portal Frontend
components.purpose: Serves the static web assets for the policyholder self-service portal.
components.rationale: Firebase Hosting provides fast, secure, and low-latency delivery of web application assets globally.
trade_offs: Requires a separate backend API for dynamic operations.
components.security_considerations: Integrated with Google Cloud Armor and SSL certificates.

components.name: Policy Core Microservices
components.purpose: Hosts the core policy lifecycle management and rating microservices.
components.rationale: GKE provides robust container orchestration, supporting zero-downtime blue/green deployments and high scalability.
trade_offs: Higher operational complexity compared to Cloud Run, but necessary for complex enterprise workloads.
components.security_considerations: Uses Workload Identity and private clusters to restrict network access.

components.validation_reason: Requires confirmation of SOAP-to-REST facade approach.
components.name: API Management & Broker Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes and secures APIs, including legacy SOAP-to-REST translation for brokers.
components.rationale: Apigee provides advanced API management, security, and mediation policies required for legacy SOAP compatibility.
trade_offs: Higher cost, but offers comprehensive enterprise API governance.
components.security_considerations: Enforces WS-Security, X.509 token validation, and rate limiting.

components.validation_reason: Requires confirmation of PostgreSQL migration strategy and PL/SQL conversion feasibility.
components.name: Relational Operational Database
components.purpose: Stores policy and claims operational data, running converted PL/SQL logic.
components.rationale: AlloyDB offers high-performance PostgreSQL compatibility with superior speed and availability, meeting strict latency and DR targets.
trade_offs: Higher cost than standard Cloud SQL, but necessary for demanding enterprise workloads.
components.security_considerations: Data is encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys and accessible only via private IP.

components.name: Policyholder Identity Provider
components.purpose: Manages authentication and identity for policyholders accessing the self-service portal.
components.rationale: Identity Platform provides a secure, developer-friendly, and highly scalable identity service.
trade_offs: Externalized identity management requires integration with backend APIs.
components.security_considerations: Supports multi-factor authentication and secure token-based access.

components.name: Enterprise Service Bus
components.purpose: Provides asynchronous messaging and event integration with Guidewire ClaimCenter.
components.rationale: Pub/Sub is a fully managed, real-time messaging service that guarantees delivery and scales automatically.
components.security_considerations: Access controlled via IAM and encrypted with Cloud KMS.

components.validation_reason: Requires confirmation of batch orchestration tool selection.
components.name: Batch Process Orchestration Engine
components.purpose: Orchestrates overnight batch jobs, financial transfers, and data warehouse feeds.
components.rationale: Cloud Composer (managed Apache Airflow) provides powerful workflow orchestration to compress the batch window.
trade_offs: Requires authoring DAGs in Python, replacing legacy Control-M configurations.
components.security_considerations: Runs in a private environment with IAM-controlled access.

components.name: Document Asset Repository
components.purpose: Stores generated policy documents, certificates, and schedules.
components.rationale: Cloud Storage provides highly durable, secure, and cost-effective object storage.
trade_offs: Requires integration with OpenText via WebDAV or API.
components.security_considerations: Enforces bucket-level IAM policies and object versioning.

components.name: Central Observability Platform
components.purpose: Monitors system health, performance metrics, and operational availability.
components.rationale: Cloud Monitoring provides deep visibility into GCP infrastructure and application performance.
trade_offs: Requires proper configuration of dashboards and alerting thresholds.
components.security_considerations: Access restricted to authorized operations staff.

components.name: Application Insights Engine
components.purpose: Provides distributed tracing to analyze latency and performance bottlenecks.
components.rationale: Cloud Trace helps optimize policy enquiry latency to meet the 400ms target.
trade_offs: Adds minor overhead to application requests.
components.security_considerations: Tracing data does not contain sensitive personally identifiable information.

components.name: Global Edge Security & WAF
components.purpose: Protects public-facing endpoints from DDoS attacks and web exploits.
components.rationale: Google Cloud Armor provides enterprise-grade security at the edge of Google's network.
trade_offs: Requires careful tuning of WAF rules to prevent false positives.
components.security_considerations: Configured with OWASP Top 10 protection rules.

components.name: Enterprise Key Vault
components.purpose: Securely stores and manages API keys, database credentials, and certificates.
components.rationale: Secret Manager provides a central, secure repository for sensitive configuration data.
trade_offs: Requires application integration to fetch secrets at runtime.
components.security_considerations: Access is strictly controlled via IAM and audited.

components.name: Enterprise CI/CD Pipeline
components.purpose: Automates the build, test, and deployment of application containers.
components.rationale: Cloud Build integrates seamlessly with GKE and supports automated blue/green deployment strategies.
components.security_considerations: Uses container analysis to scan for vulnerabilities before deployment.

components.name: Infrastructure as Code Engine
components.purpose: Provisions and manages GCP resources using declarative configuration.
components.rationale: Infrastructure Manager automates environment provisioning, ensuring consistency across dev, test, and prod.
components.security_considerations: Enforces state file encryption and access controls.

environments.dev: Sandbox environment with minimal sizing, using Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instead of AlloyDB to optimize costs.
environments.test: Staging environment mirroring production configuration for performance testing and integration validation.
environments.prod: Highly available multi-zone production environment with full AlloyDB clustering and GKE autoscaling.

deployment_runtime.text: The deployment runtime leverages Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) for containerized microservices, managed via Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy to support zero-downtime blue/green deployments.

availability_scalability.text: High availability is achieved through multi-zone GKE clusters and AlloyDB for PostgreSQL, with Cloud Load Balancing distributing traffic and autoscaling to handle up to 1.2 million users.

backup_dr.text: Disaster recovery is supported by AlloyDB cross-region replication and automated backups to Cloud Storage, ensuring an RPO of 15 minutes and RTO of 4 hours.

observability.text: Observability is established using Cloud Monitoring for infrastructure metrics and Cloud Trace for distributed tracing to guarantee policy enquiry latency remains under 400ms.

security_controls.text: Security controls include Google Cloud Armor for WAF protection, Secret Manager for credential storage, and Cloud Logging for immutable audit trails retained for 10 years.
